objective: Concentrate resources on four mechanism-first directions with the highest information value after wave-one falsification. Produce empirical falsification evidence where lawful data exists and start bounded prospective public-data capture where it does not.

authority.carry_correction: The contract-compliant corrected carry engine terminated both sleeves in December 2020 and has 0.0% position, funding yield, and strategy return in 2024. The 12.38%-13.87% figures are arithmetic-only diagnostics for an inadmissible frozen approximately-2x-gross zero-collateral path; they are not corrected-engine economics.
authority.corrected_audit_limitation: The corrected-audit run.py returns SOFR rate/360 per calendar day but assigns that value to every hourly observation, over-accruing the benchmark by approximately 24x. Its benchmark and excess-return outputs are invalid. New work must independently implement and test daily-versus-hourly accrual; only its signed-funding parsing, December-2020 collateral terminations, and zero 2024 position/funding remain authoritative.

epistemic_windows.rule: Every historical window is retrospective because the direction ranking was selected in 2026 with knowledge of later evidence. Historical results may falsify or calibrate mechanics but cannot confirm durable alpha. Only append-only observations after campaign creation are prospective.

global_constraints: Research only: no live orders, account access, credentials, private endpoints, messages, or infrastructure mutation.
Use public unauthenticated sources and record source URL, retrieval time, terms, byte size, and SHA-256.
Raw downloads and live capture belong under quant-trading/data/raw/focused/ and remain ignored by Git.

No borrowing or hidden cross-margin credit. Empirical portfolios must keep spot plus derivative gross exposure <= 1.0x NAV, cash >= 0, and each venue collateral above maintenance plus a declared isolation buffer.
Funding is signed exactly. Negative funding paid by shorts remains negative. Duplicate snapped events fail closed rather than selecting a sign.
SOFR is carried forward over calendar days and accrued ACT/360 exactly once per day; hourly simulation must divide the daily accrual across hours.
Maximum eight preregistered variants per empirical direction. Do not rescue a failed gate with thresholds, leverage, longer stops, or a new benchmark.
Report 1x and 2x costs, gross and net exposure, turnover, collateral path, liquidations, benchmark excess, drawdown, and every trial.
A missing lawful dataset yields an honest feasibility/capture result, not synthetic history or an alpha claim.

Bound each agent raw-data acquisition to 1 GiB. Each prospective capture process must rotate at 256 MiB per UTC day, fail closed at 10 GiB cumulative storage, and never delete prior capture automatically.

shared_output_contract.capture_directions: Use run.py for bounded smoke/replay and capture.py for the persistent collector. capture_status records the collector lifecycle separately from strategy status. A preregistered capture-backed mechanism screen may resolve falsified without a strategy-return series by setting strategy.returns_applicable=false; otherwise returns.csv is required for empirical validation-pass/falsified status. Header-only return files are prohibited.
shared_output_contract.determinism: Fixed seeds, stable sorting, UTC timestamps, no current-time values inside computed historical results except retrieval metadata.
